messages:
irina: heads up — during the SA rotation for private control plane in eu-west we spotted unexpected admin grants in the audit stream. not sure if rotation script or iam mapping bug. any eyes?

sam: on it. which rotation run? the nightly job or the ad-hoc rotate?

irina: ad-hoc rotate triggered by onboarding flow, svc-account: svc-rotator-eu. rotation completed ~1795004200 but audit shows iam.setPolicy with extra grants at 1795004230.

alex: can you paste the audit log line?

irina: sure — snippet below (redacted):
```
{"timestamp":"2026-07-03T03:30:30Z","actor":"svc-rotator-eu","action":"iam.setPolicy","resource":"projects/redwood-private-controlplane","protoPayload":{"serviceAccountEmail":"svc-internal-worker@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","changes":[{"role":"roles/owner","member":"serviceAccount:svc-internal-worker@..."}]}}
```

raj: whoa — roles/owner got assigned? that looks like escalation. do we have a mapping that defaults to owner on missing role?

sam: our rotation code merges desired policy with existing policy. bug hypothesis: when desired policy list empty it falls back to cluster-default which currently contains owner in the private controlplane project. will validate.

jen: customer-facing note: one Dedicated customer with private control plane might be affected; i've flagged CS to hold alerts.

alex: check KMS envelope operations too — if rotation touches key-wrapping and our KMS ACL mapping is wrong we could be granting accidental access. which key used?

irina: kms key: projects/redwood/locations/eu/keyRdw-private-1. rotation call used kms.encrypt then store to secret manager.

sam: running ad-hoc queries now.

deploy-bot: deployment #deploy-1721 succeeded for infra/sa-rotator at 1795004185 :white_check_mark:

sam: query results: there are 3 iam.setPolicy entries from svc-rotator-eu in a 2min window. two of them introduce roles/editor and one introduces roles/owner. Looks like a race where concurrent calls replace binding instead of patching.

alex: confirm if this only touches private control plane project or service accounts across Dedicated customers. we need scope.

sam: grep across logs — matches in private-controlplane-* projects only, not public hosted projects.

irina: ok so likely rotation code path uses project-level default bindings for private control plane. root cause candidate: config overlay for private deployments has an old defaultBindings file with owner for svc-internal-worker.

raj: mitigation steps?

sam: immediate: revoke the newly added owner binding, rotate keys for svc-internal-worker, and block the rotator service account from iam.setPolicy via a deny policy until we patch. also add an audit alert for iam.setPolicy introducing owner role.

alex: I already created a quick deny via org policy (temporary) to prevent granting roles/owner to service accounts by lateral actors. applying now.

irina: i pushed a hotfix to the rotation job: change replace -> patch and add explicit binding whitelist. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/sa-rotator/pull/945

sam: tests: added fuzz to ensure merge doesn't introduce owner-level bindings. will run canary in staging then promote to prod.

jen: CS asked whether any customer data was read. audit shows no data-access API calls from svc-internal-worker between 1795004230-1795004300, only iam changes. told them no data exfil.

alex: next items — KMS rotation flow needs idempotency and explicit ACLs. also add an eval rule in console to flag when a role higher than roles/editor is added via rotation.

raj: opening incident ticket: INC-2026-1347. tagging PD and sec oncall.

irina: note for private deployments: double-check VPC allowlist automation — the allowlist tool accidentally uses the service account email as a CIDR key for some lookups in older versions, unrelated but found while investigating. opened GH issue infra/allowlist#212.

sam: good catch. will audit allowlist tool for string parsing bugs.

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-1347 created by alex.

irina: next steps: revoke owner binding + confirm rollback, finish PR + canary, add postmortem template items (how rotation code defaults are managed, add unit + integration tests, add audit alert for owner grants). i'll own postmortem.

alex: assigning follow-ups: sam (hotfix + canary), irina (postmortem), raj (deny policy & PD rotation), jen (customer comms).

jen: ack. i'll draft a customer-safe message and coordinate with legal if needed.

sam: hotfix merged to prod at 1795004920, canary shows no further owner grants. full roll complete.

irina: thanks everyone. we should update runbooks: rotation-runbook.md and private-controlplane-security.md to include this scenario.

alex: adding regression alert: "rotation-introduced-owner" with severity high.

raj: closing thread for now, will follow up in incident ticket. :lock:
